artifact_policy: No artifact gate performed. Future canonical/single/repeated gates reuse Stage A-B fingerprints, LocalLoad semantics, no reload, unspecialized R, zero spill, matched candidate residency and archived exact CUBIN SHA closure. Failed/missing evidence excludes or remains pending without changing structural membership.
domain_rationale: M16 is one power-of-two below the development M32/64/128 range; M256/512 are above it. Deliberate extrapolation, never prune for expected PRIMARY membership or performance.

future_analysis.PRIMARY: Continuous unrounded Spearman(G,D), exact-tie average ranks; n<3/constant UNDEFINED; LOO same minimum n; complete nine-grid signs and coverage; PRIMARY n<5 insufficient for established generalization
future_analysis.SECONDARY: Separate Pearson(G,D), complete signs/coverage/counterexamples, lower equivalence strength; no merged primary evidence
future_analysis.hypothesis_predictions: Use the locked Stage D ALL_ELIGIBLE model coefficients for prospective held-out predictions; no refitting or hypothesis changes after Phase 5 outcomes. Evaluate all timing-eligible cases; failed/singular scopes remain INCONCLUSIVE.
future_analysis.metrics: G=b_canonical_default-b_canonical_4; g0/g1=repeated differentials; D=g1-g0; G-D descriptive only; three invocation values, means, sample SDs
future_analysis.slopes: Per invocation condition median of 100 samples; 3-B OLS, ns/additional CTA; retain all R2/residuals and cases
future_analysis.threshold_policy: No p-values, significance claim or tuned support cutoff. Directional/paired-error comparisons below test specified hypotheses and do not automatically establish generalization or causality.

future_timing.primitive: CUDA events, one exact archived kernel per scalar sample; SHA guard before every launch
future_timing.protocol_failures: Invalid entire invocation; retain failure and partial data; only whole affected invocation repair, never rerun unfavorable outcomes
future_timing.resource_pending: If allocation/compiled resources are illegal or unknown, STRUCTURAL_OR_RESOURCE_PENDING; do not change B_DESC/B_RUN/R, add amplification, or silently adapt the protocol
future_timing.warmup_order: First frozen round, untimed, same rule for candidates/harnesses/R/B

hierarchy.PRIMARY: Both candidates exact sequence in canonical-single reproduction AND repeated runtime-body reproduction, with all frozen isolation/resource gates passed
hierarchy.SECONDARY: All gates passed, but one or more complete bodies are PIPELINED_OPCODE_EQUIVALENT; never upgrade based on outcomes
hierarchy.coverage: n>=5 permits considering generalization only within observed exact-equivalence coverage; does not itself establish it. Report M/N/warp/lane coverage and anchor-free held-out scope.
hierarchy.others: EXCLUDE_FROM_TIMING or PENDING; no performance-based selection

hypotheses.confirmation_data: Unmeasured Phase 5 held-out domain; no use of Stage C for confirmation
hypotheses.falsifying_future_observation: Held-out PRIMARY n>=5 with nonconstant G/D and negative Spearman(G,D) contradicts the directional prediction.
hypotheses.hypothesis: Within the newly gated exact-sequence scope, G and D have a positive continuous rank association.
hypotheses.inconclusive: PRIMARY n<5, constant/undefined correlation, or rho=0; no rescue by adding development data or upgrading PIPELINED cases.
hypotheses.lock_policy: Do not alter hypothesis, scope, equations or comparison criteria after Phase 5 timing
hypotheses.mechanistic_rationale: Exact body reproduction preserves the frozen instruction sequence projection; variation in a body advantage may track canonical marginal cost within that equivalence scope, subject to context interactions.

observed_motivation.limitation: Development n=3, one anchor and two new shapes; LOO/new-only undefined. This is not established generalization.

hypotheses.scope: Every Phase 5 PRIMARY case admitted by the future frozen-equivalence artifact gate, across the full 24-source domain; no N64/w8 structural filter.
hypotheses.supporting_future_observation: Held-out PRIMARY n>=5 with nonconstant G/D and positive Spearman(G,D) supports the directional prediction; report full sign agreement, effect sizes and coverage, without automatic established-generalization status.

hypotheses.confirmation_data: Unmeasured Phase 5 held-out domain; no use of Stage C for confirmation
hypotheses.falsifying_future_observation: On that same held-out set, MAE_B<MAE_A and RMSE_B<RMSE_A contradict the specified non-improvement prediction.
hypotheses.hypothesis: Adding the fixed-harness differential alone does not improve prospective prediction over the body-only linear model.
hypotheses.inconclusive: Mixed MAE/RMSE ordering, fewer than five eligible cases, invalid protocol or undefined predictions; no refitting or performance-driven exclusions.
hypotheses.lock_policy: Do not alter hypothesis, scope, equations or comparison criteria after Phase 5 timing
hypotheses.mechanistic_rationale: Small R=0 differentials coexist with opposed/unresolved-body canonical outcomes. Fixed work need not capture register/live-range/scheduling interactions between the repeated and canonical execution contexts.
hypotheses.scope: All Phase 5 timing-eligible PRIMARY/SECONDARY cases; separately display strata and coverage. A/B are frozen descriptive predictors, not causal cost components.
hypotheses.supporting_future_observation: Using the locked development A/B coefficients on all held-out timing-eligible cases (n>=5), MAE_B>=MAE_A and RMSE_B>=RMSE_A support the specified non-improvement prediction.

hypotheses.confirmation_data: Unmeasured Phase 5 held-out domain; no use of Stage C for confirmation
hypotheses.falsifying_future_observation: Under that coverage, MAE_C>=MAE_B and RMSE_C>=RMSE_B contradict the specified predictive extension.
hypotheses.hypothesis: The registered warp-regime covariate carries additional predictive context beyond D and g0 on held-out extrapolation cases.
hypotheses.inconclusive: Mixed MAE/RMSE ordering, fewer than three cases in either warp regime or undefined predictions; no new model terms or refitting.
hypotheses.lock_policy: Do not alter hypothesis, scope, equations or comparison criteria after Phase 5 timing
hypotheses.mechanistic_rationale: Warp count changes per-thread work and inter-warp execution context. The covariate may proxy those changes or other correlated codegen features; it is not an identified causal warp effect or an always-warp8 rule.
hypotheses.scope: Entire Phase 5 timing-eligible cohort, across both warp regimes and full new-M domain. Does not select structural membership or establish production heuristics.
hypotheses.supporting_future_observation: Using locked development B/C coefficients on all held-out timing-eligible cases with at least three cases in each warp regime, MAE_C<MAE_B and RMSE_C<RMSE_B support the specified predictive extension.

scope_preservation: Stage A-C membership, classes, evidence and scientific status remain unchanged; no production heuristic or PR modification
statistical_role: held-out confirmatory extension for OUTCOME_INFORMED_HYPOTHESIS; Stage C is development/hypothesis-generation data and cannot confirm these hypotheses
structural_rule: Reuse Stage A default/cand4 legal, distinct supported layouts, unchanged warpPart[M], strictly decreasing lanePart[M], M reduction axis, unchanged num_warps. Source-rule predictions require later actual-artifact verification.
